`.claude/skills/verify/` was generated on 2026-10-06. It's local-only, because `.claude/` is gitignored.

**Architecture (since the 2026-10-26 evening rewrite).** The user asked for a plan covering every option (languages, scripts, binaries, CLIs) for this machine only, and then chose:
- a Go lifecycle binary
- Playwright Test specs
- one shared instance
- a manual gc

Earlier that day: a Bash/nushell/pwsh/Python benchmark showed equal verify time, then a Python + ruff/ty rebuild. Both are replaced. A tarball of the Python stack existed only in that session's scratchpad.

**The binary.** `bin/gitea-verify` is built from the skill dir's `*.go`: stdlib only, its own `go.mod` (`verify.local/gitea-verify`), macOS-only, with its own `.golangci.yml` because Gitea's bans `encoding/json` and `fmt.Print`.
- Commands: `up [--owner pid] [--json]`, `doctor [--json]`, `down`, `list`, `prune`, `gc [--keep N] [--dry-run]`, `test <spec|path>... | --all [playwright flags]`.
- State is `state.json`.
- The `--owner` watchdog uses kqueue `NOTE_EXIT` and trusts the event, not `kill(pid,0)`: a SIGKILLed owner stays a zombie until reaped. That bug was found live.
- `ours()` matches the run's unique `web --config <run>/work/custom/conf/app.ini`, so only that PID is ever killed.
- `gc` only touches down dirs named like run IDs. It skips hand-named evidence dirs such as `issue-62-before`.

**Playwright.** `playwright.config.ts`, `fixtures.ts`, `global-setup.ts`, `run.ts`, `specs/<feature>.spec.ts`.
- 4 workers on one instance, `retries: 0`, traces on failure, and an HTML report under the run's artifacts.
- Admin `storageState` comes from one real login per run.
- An auto fixture fails on context `weberror`. It ignores WebKit's navigation-abort `TypeError: Load failed`, WebKit only.
- `test` defaults to `--project=chromium`. Flags after the spec names go to Playwright (mise swallows `--`).
- Scratchpad specs import `fixtures.ts` by absolute path. `test` writes a `{"type":"module"}` package.json next to them.

**mise and the map.** The gitignored root `mise.toml` has `verify:bin`, `verify:check` (gofumpt, vet, go test, golangci-lint via `nix shell --inputs-from`, tsc), `verify:test`, `verify:all`, `verify:gc` and the lifecycle tasks. There are no per-feature tasks any more. The feature map has 10 features, and their H2 is now `Driving it`. `verify-map`'s `check-map.sh` checks three views: features, specs and the README.

**Timing on 2026-10-26.** All 11 tests took about 22 s wall (19 s at 6+ workers) on one instance, against about 50 s serial before. A WebKit run with `--repeat-each=2` passed.

**Found during the rewrite: #60 branch regression (PR #121).** After the `?` help dialog has been opened and closed once, Escape in the repo S search box returns focus to the dialog's opener button instead of the body. It reproduces every time after closing with the dialog's Close button, and only intermittently in `specs/shortcuts.spec.ts` (`toBody` after typing `a?`, 4 fails, then several passes). Reported to the user, not fixed.
- `EVENT_SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME = 500ms` (from `tools/test-e2e.sh`) was tried and reverted: the notifications page re-renders its filter dropdowns mid-click.

- `session({name, user, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]})` signs a context in as a second account. `api()` stays admin, so use `?sudo=<user>` for that user's API view.

Traps it doesn't cover:
- **Firefox is CI-only.** Firefox 1532 hangs at launch on this Mac (macOS 27.0.1 `sandbox_extension_issue_file_to_process`), even outside Claude's sandbox, and there's no docker/podman for `PLAYWRIGHT_MODE=container`. Run e2e locally with `--project=chromium --project=webkit`, with the Claude sandbox disabled.
- **Two dropdowns on the appearance page.** `/user/settings/appearance` has two `.ui.selection.dropdown` elements, for theme and language. Scope to `form[action$="/theme"]`.
- **A modal `<dialog>` hides a missing key guard.** `showModal()` makes the page inert, so a focus shortcut like `s` can't fire behind it even with no guard. Prove a "no shortcuts while open" rule with a navigation key (`g i`) and a check that fails if the page navigates. Re-proven on 2026-10-26: removing the `dialog[open]` guard fails the spec at `g i`.
- **Doctor's freshness is mtime-only.** A bundle built on another branch can pass doctor and still not match this branch's source. `sed` on PATH is GNU, so `sed -i ''` rewrites a file unchanged and bumps its mtime. That is how #60's real bundle got built mid-rewrite.
- **Injecting markup.** `page.evaluate` can inject markup into any Gitea page and render it with real component CSS, which is useful without a populated repo.

**Why:** The user's own :3000 instance (`custom/conf/app.ini`, `data/`) and its accounts must not be disturbed. Driving a separate disposable instance avoids that.
**How to apply:**
- Use `/verify` for UI proofs, and run the matching saved spec first.
- Never stop servers by process name; `gitea-verify down` kills only the PID it started.
- Keep the map current with `/verify-map`: `add` after each user-facing PR (#60 isn't mapped yet), `audit` after a batch of merges.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-27 01:54:52Z)**_

I'd port only the Go lifecycle binary to SBCL Common Lisp and leave the Playwright Test specs in TypeScript. No Lisp has a Playwright binding that matches Playwright Test's workers, fixtures, `storageState`, traces and HTML report, and the specs depend on all of those.

**The binary in SBCL** (about 1,000 lines of Go today across `main/commands/doctor/proc/state.go`):
- **Build:** an ASDF system, packaged as a standalone executable with `sb-ext:save-lisp-and-die :executable t :compression t`. It would still land at `bin/gitea-verify`, so the `mise` tasks wouldn't change.
- **Processes:** `sb-ext:run-program` to start `gitea web --config …`, and `sb-posix` for `kill`/`waitpid`. The `ours()` check that only kills the run's own PID ports directly: it runs `ps` and matches the run's `app.ini` path.
- **The `--owner` watchdog** is the only hard part. SBCL has no kqueue wrapper, so `kqueue`/`kevent` and `NOTE_EXIT` would go through `sb-alien` (or CFFI). It must keep the current behaviour of trusting the event and never polling `kill(pid,0)`, because that polling bug was already found live with zombie owners.
- **JSON for `state.json` and `--json`:** one dependency, `com.inuoe.jzon`, pinned with ocicl or Quicklisp. That ends the "stdlib only" property the Go version has.
- **Tests:** `main_test.go` would become a FiveAM or Parachute suite run from `verify:check`. Lint would drop to compiler warnings treated as errors, since nothing in Lisp matches golangci-lint.

**If the specs had to be Lisp too:** Clojure on the JVM is the only workable option, using Playwright for Java through interop. You'd have to rebuild the worker pool, fixtures, retries, trace-on-failure and reporting yourself on `clojure.test` (and Java Playwright has no test runner). JVM startup would also eat into the ~22 s full run.

I wouldn't do it, though. The Go binary is stdlib-only, macOS-specific and already debugged. A Lisp port adds a dependency and FFI code for kqueue, and verification doesn't get faster because the browser and Gitea dominate the run time. If you want it anyway as an exercise, port the binary to SBCL and leave the specs alone.

What about Rust?

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-27 01:55:59Z)**_

Rust fits the binary much better than Lisp did, but the specs would still stay in TypeScript.

**Porting the binary** is straightforward:
- **kqueue watchdog:** the `nix` crate's `nix::sys::event` exposes `kqueue`/`kevent` with `EVFILT_PROC` and `NOTE_EXIT`, so there's no hand-written FFI. You'd keep the rule of trusting the event and never polling `kill(pid,0)`.
- **Processes:** `std::process::Command` to start `gitea web --config …`, and `nix::sys::signal::kill` to stop it. `ours()` ports directly: read `ps` output and match the run's `app.ini` path.
- **State and `--json`:** `serde` and `serde_json` with derived structs for `state.json`. This replaces the Go `encoding/json` that needed its own `.golangci.yml` exemption.
- **CLI:** `clap` with derive gives you `up/doctor/down/list/prune/gc/test` almost for free. To keep the dependency count near Go's zero, hand-roll the parsing like the Go version does and stop at `nix` plus `serde_json`.
- **Checks:** `verify:check` would become `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -D warnings` and `cargo test`. Clippy is a real equivalent to golangci-lint, which Lisp didn't have. The toolchain can come from `nix shell` like golangci-lint does now.
- **Build:** `cargo build --release`, copied to `bin/gitea-verify`, so the mise tasks keep their names.

**The specs** have no maintained Rust equivalent of Playwright Test:
- `playwright-rust` is abandoned.
- `chromiumoxide` speaks CDP, so it's Chromium only and you'd lose WebKit.
- `fantoccini` uses WebDriver, and on macOS the only WebKit driver is Safari's `safaridriver`, not Playwright's WebKit build.
- Any of these means rebuilding workers, fixtures, `storageState`, traces and the HTML report yourself.

Verification wouldn't get faster: Gitea startup and the browser take almost all of the ~22 s. The real gains would be stricter types around `state.json` and the PID handling, plus clippy. The costs are crate dependencies and slower builds where Go uses only its standard library. I'd do it only if you'd rather maintain Rust than Go. The Go binary works, and swapping languages fixes nothing that's broken.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-27 01:58:03Z)**_

Node is the strongest of the three alternatives, because the specs, `fixtures.ts` and `run.ts` already run on it. Porting the binary would put the whole skill in one language and one toolchain, with no Go build. The catch is the `--owner` watchdog.

**Node (v26 installed):**
- **No build step:** Node 26 runs `.ts` files directly through type stripping. `gitea-verify` could become a small shim that runs `node cli.ts`, and `verify:check` would drop gofumpt, vet and golangci-lint, keeping `tsc`.
- **Processes:** `child_process.spawn(..., {detached: true}).unref()` starts Gitea, and `process.kill` stops it. `ours()` keeps working by parsing `ps` output.
- **JSON:** `state.json` and `--json` are built in.
- **The watchdog is the problem.** Node has no kqueue API and can't wait on a PID it didn't start. The only stdlib option is polling `process.kill(pid, 0)`, which is the bug you already hit: a SIGKILLed owner stays a zombie, so the check keeps saying it's alive. Two ways around it:
  - poll `ps -o stat= -p <pid>` and treat state `Z` as dead too, which is polling but correct
  - write a native N-API addon for kqueue, which needs a C compiler and brings back a build step

**Bun (1.4.2 installed):**
- `bun:ffi` can `dlopen` libc and call `kqueue`/`kevent` directly. That keeps the event-driven `NOTE_EXIT` watchdog with no compiler.
- `bun build --compile` produces a single binary at `bin/gitea-verify`, much like Go does today.
- Playwright Test doesn't officially support Bun, so the `test` command would still run `playwright test` under Node. That gives you two runtimes again, and `bun:ffi` is still marked experimental.

On balance, I'd go with Node and the `ps`-based zombie check if you want one language. It's the only option here that actually simplifies the skill: one toolchain and a smaller `verify:check`. Bun keeps the watchdog clean, but you'd be relying on an experimental FFI and still running two runtimes. As with Rust and Lisp, verification wouldn't get faster.

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

CONTAINER_RUNTIME="${CONTAINER_RUNTIME:-docker}"
CONTAINER_NAME="gitea-e2e-runner-$$"

free_port() {
  node -e "const s=require('net').createServer();s.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',()=>{process.stdout.write(String(s.address().port));s.close()})"
}

detect_playwright_mode() {
  if [ "${PLAYWRIGHT_MODE:-auto}" = "local" ] || [ "${PLAYWRIGHT_MODE:-auto}" = "container" ]; then
    return
  fi

  PLAYWRIGHT_MODE="local"

  if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Linux" ]; then
    # playwright only supports ubuntu/debian officially
    if ! grep -qE '^ID(_LIKE)?=.*(ubuntu|debian)' /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null; then
        PLAYWRIGHT_MODE="container"
    fi
  fi
}

wait_for_container() {
  local max_wait=30
  local elapsed=0
  echo "Waiting for container to start..."
  while ! (echo > "/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER_PORT") 2>/dev/null; do
    if [ "$("$CONTAINER_RUNTIME" inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$CONTAINER_NAME" 2>/dev/null)" != "true" ]; then
      echo "Error: container exited before becoming ready." >&2
      "$CONTAINER_RUNTIME" logs "$CONTAINER_NAME" >&2 || true
      return 1
    fi
    if [ "$elapsed" -ge "$max_wait" ]; then
      echo "Error: container did not become ready after ${max_wait}s." >&2
      "$CONTAINER_RUNTIME" logs "$CONTAINER_NAME" >&2 || true
      return 1
    fi
    sleep 1
    elapsed=$((elapsed + 1))
  done
  echo "Container is ready."
}

CMD="${1:-run}"
if [ "$CMD" = "install" ] || [ "$CMD" = "run" ]; then
  [ $# -gt 0 ] && shift
else
  CMD="run"
fi

detect_playwright_mode

if [ "$PLAYWRIGHT_MODE" = "container" ]; then
  if ! command -v "$CONTAINER_RUNTIME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "error: PLAYWRIGHT_MODE=container but '$CONTAINER_RUNTIME' is not installed." >&2
    echo "Install docker/podman or set CONTAINER_RUNTIME to an available runtime." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION=$(sed -n 's/.*"@playwright\/test"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^[:digit:]]*\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' package.json)
  if ! [[ "$PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.]+)?$ ]]; then
    echo "error: invalid @playwright/test version in package.json: '${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}'" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  PLAYWRIGHT_IMAGE="mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION}-noble"
fi

if [ "$CMD" = "install" ]; then
  if [ "$PLAYWRIGHT_MODE" = "local" ]; then
    # on GitHub Actions VMs, playwright's system deps are pre-installed for chromium and firefox
    if [ -z "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" ]; then

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-27 02:00:06Z)**_

The most logical setup is a Go lifecycle binary plus Playwright Test specs in TypeScript, which is what `/verify` already uses.

**Playwright Test (TS) for driving the browser.** This choice is settled by the repo itself:
- `package.json` already pins `@playwright/test`.
- Upstream's `tests/e2e/*.test.ts` and `make test-e2e` use it, and so does CI.
- A verify spec can be promoted into `tests/e2e/` for a PR with little rewriting. Nothing else allows that.
- It covers Chromium and WebKit, with workers, fixtures, `storageState`, traces and HTML reports built in.

**Go for the instance lifecycle.** The work is starting a disposable Gitea, health-checking it, keeping it up between agent commands, killing only its own PID, and running a watchdog on the owner:
- Go is already required to build Gitea, so this adds no toolchain.
- The standard library's `syscall` package exposes kqueue `NOTE_EXIT`, which gives an event-driven watchdog that handles zombie owners, with no dependencies and no FFI.
- It compiles to one static binary.

**Why not the other options:**
- **Upstream `tools/test-e2e.sh`** starts and stops Gitea per run, and `make test-e2e` rebuilds the frontend and backend each time. It can't keep an instance up for screenshots in between.
- **Playwright's `webServer` option** has the same per-run limit and doesn't do safe teardown.
- **Bash or Python:** an earlier benchmark showed no speed gain, and their process control is weaker.
- **Node or Bun:** Node can't watch an arbitrary PID exit without polling or a native addon. Bun's FFI is experimental, and Playwright Test still needs Node.
- **Rust, Lisp or anything else:** each adds a toolchain the repo doesn't need, and none is faster, because Gitea startup and the browser dominate the run time.

The one change I'd consider is writing new specs in the `tests/e2e` style, so moving them into a PR is a copy rather than a port.

import {env} from 'node:process';
import {expect} from '@playwright/test';
import type {APIRequestContext, Locator, Page} from '@playwright/test';

/** Generate a random alphanumeric string. */
export function randomString(length: number): string {
  const chars = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
  let result = '';
  for (let index = 0; index < length; index++) {
    result += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }
  return result;
}

export const timeoutFactor = Number(env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_TIMEOUT_FACTOR) || 1;

export function baseUrl() {
  return env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_URL?.replace(/\/$/g, '');
}

function apiAuthHeader(username: string, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: string) {
  return {Authorization: `Basic ${globalThis.btoa(`${username}:${[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]}`)}`};
}

export function apiHeaders() {
  return apiAuthHeader(env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_USER, env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_PASSWORD);
}

async function apiRetry(fn: () => Promise<{ok: () => boolean; status: () => number; text: () => Promise<string>}>, label: string) {
  const maxAttempts = 5;
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxAttempts; attempt++) {
    const response = await fn();
    if (response.ok()) return;
    if ([500, 502, 503].includes(response.status()) && attempt < maxAttempts - 1) {
      const jitter = Math.random() * 500;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000 * (attempt + 1) + jitter));
      continue;
    }
    throw new Error(`${label} failed: ${response.status()} ${await response.text()}`);
  }
}

export async function createProject(
  page: Page,
  {owner, repo, title}: {owner: string; repo: string; title: string},
): Promise<{id: number}> {
  // Navigate to new project page
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/projects/new`);

  // Fill in project details
  await page.getByLabel('Title').fill(title);

  // Submit the form
  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Create Project'}).click();

  // Wait for redirect to projects list
  await page.waitForURL(new RegExp(`/${owner}/${repo}/projects$`));

  // Extract the project ID from the project link in the list
  const projectLink = page.locator('.milestone-list > .item').filter({hasText: title}).locator('a').first();
  const href = await projectLink.getAttribute('href');
  const match = /\/projects\/(\d+)/.exec(href || '');
  const id = match ? parseInt(match[1]) : 0;

  return {id};
}

export async function apiCreateIssue(
  requestContext: APIRequestContext,
  {owner, repo, title, body, projects, milestone, headers}: {
    owner: string;
    repo: string;
    title: string;
    body?: string;
    projects?: number[];
    milestone?: number;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
  },
): Promise<{index: number}> {
  let result: {index: number} = {index: 0};
  await apiRetry(async () => {
    const response = await requestContext.post(`${baseUrl()}/api/v1/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues`, {
      headers: headers || apiHeaders(),
      data: {title, body: body || '', projects: projects || [], ...(milestone && {milestone})},
    });
    if (response.ok()) {
      const json = await response.json();
      // API returns "number" field for the issue index
      result = {index: json.number};
    }
    return response;
  }, 'apiCreateIssue');
  return result;
}

/* asserts the child has no horizontal inset from its parent — catches padding/border anywhere
 * in between regardless of which element declares it */
export async function assertFlushWithParent(child: Locator, parent: Locator) {
  const [childBox, parentBox] = await Promise.all([child.boundingBox(), parent.boundingBox()]);
  if (!childBox || !parentBox) throw new Error('boundingBox returned null');
  expect(childBox.x).toBe(parentBox.x);
  expect(childBox.width).toBe(parentBox.width);
}

// covers what happy-dom can't: native button activation on Space keyup and the browser's own Tab move
test('aria-menu is operable by keyboard', async ({page}) => {
  await page.goto('/devtest/aria-menu');
  const trigger = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Text items'});
  const menu = page.getByRole('menu').filter({has: page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Apple'})});
  const output = page.locator('#devtest-aria-menu-output');

  await trigger.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Apple'})).toBeFocused();

  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Grape'})).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('b');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Banana'})).toBeFocused();

  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await expect(menu).toBeHidden();
  await expect(trigger).toBeFocused();

  // Space on a native button must open the menu and not re-toggle it shut on keyup
  await page.keyboard.press(' ');
  await expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Apple'})).toBeFocused();
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
  await page.keyboard.press(' ');
  await expect(output).toHaveText('Banana');
  await expect(trigger).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  await expect(trigger).toBeFocused();

  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
  await page.keyboard.press('Tab');
  await expect(menu).toBeHidden();
  await expect(trigger).not.toBeFocused(); // the browser's Tab moved on from the trigger

  await assertNoJsError(page);
});

/** The admin's REST client: seed state and read it back; `?sudo=<user>` acts as someone else. */
export type Api = (method: string, path: string, body?: unknown) => Promise<any>;

function makeApi(run: RunState): Api {
  const auth = `Basic ${Buffer.from(`${run.user}:${run.[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]}`).toString('base64')}`;
  return async (method, path, body) => {
    const res = await fetch(`${run.url}/api/v1${path}`, {
      method,
      headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: auth},
      body: body === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(body),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000), // a hung server fails the spec instead of stalling it
    });
    const text = await res.text();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${method} ${path} -> ${res.status} ${text}`);
    return text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
  };
}

export type Evidence = {
  dir: string,
  /** a full-page screenshot plus an ARIA snapshot of the same moment, numbered in capture order */
  capture: (what: string) => Promise<string>,
  /** stored state read back through the API, as NN-<what>.json */
  note: (what: string, data: unknown) => void,
};

const steps = new Map<string, number>();

// WebKit rejects a fetch still in flight when the page navigates away ("Load failed"); Chromium drops it silently
const ignored = (browser: string, e: string) => browser === 'webkit' && e === 'Unhandled Promise Rejection: TypeError: Load failed';

const specName = (info: TestInfo) => basename(info.file).replace(/\.spec\.ts$/, '');

/** artifacts/<name>/, suffixed with the browser when it isn't chromium so a webkit run keeps its own evidence */
function dirFor(run: RunState, name: string, info: TestInfo): string {
  const dir = join(run.artifacts, info.project.name === 'chromium' ? name : `${name}-${info.project.name}`);
  mkdirSync(dir, {recursive: true});
  return dir;
}

function evidence(page: Page, run: RunState, name: string, info: TestInfo): Evidence {
  const dir = dirFor(run, name, info);
  const label = (s: string) => {
    const n = (steps.get(dir) ?? 0) + 1;
    steps.set(dir, n);
    return `${String(n).padStart(2, '0')}-${s}`;
  };
  return {
    dir,
    async capture(what) {
      const file = join(dir, label(what));
      await page.screenshot({path: `${file}.png`, fullPage: true});
      writeFileSync(`${file}.aria.yml`, await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot());
      await info.attach(basename(file), {path: `${file}.png`, contentType: 'image/png'});
      return file;
    },
    note(what, data) {
      writeFileSync(join(dir, `${label(what)}.json`), JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
    },
  };
}

export type SessionOptions = {
  /** artifacts subdirectory */
  name: string,
  /** sign in as a user the spec created; without one the browser is verify-admin (or anonymous with login: false) */
  user?: string,
  [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]?: string,
  login?: boolean,
  viewport?: {width: number, height: number},
  /** 2 for PR screenshots */
  deviceScaleFactor?: number,
};

export type Session = Evidence & {page: Page, user: string};

type Fixtures = {
  run: RunState,
  api: Api,
  /** who `page` is signed in as: verify-admin */
  user: string,
  /** evidence for `page`, under artifacts/<spec name>/ */
  s: Evidence,
  /** another browser context: a second account, an anonymous visitor, or a different viewport */
  session: (opts: SessionOptions) => Promise<Session>,
  jsErrors: string[],
};

export const test = base.extend<Fixtures>({
  run: async ({}, use) => use(loadRun()), // eslint-disable-line no-empty-pattern
  api: async ({run}, use) => use(makeApi(run)),
  user: async ({run}, use) => use(run.user),
  // a proof with uncaught page errors is not a proof: fails the test after it ends, in every context it opened
  jsErrors: [async ({run}, use, info) => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    await use(errors);
    writeFileSync(join(dirFor(run, specName(info), info), 'js-errors.json'), JSON.stringify(errors, null, 2));
    expect(errors, 'uncaught page errors').toEqual([]);
  }, {auto: true}],
  context: async ({context, jsErrors}, use, info) => {
    context.on('weberror', (e) => ignored(info.project.name, String(e.error())) || jsErrors.push(String(e.error())));
    await use(context);
  },
  s: async ({page, run}, use, info) => use(evidence(page, run, specName(info), info)),
  session: async ({browser, run, jsErrors}, use, info) => {
    const opened: BrowserContext[] = [];
    await use(async ({name, user, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]], login = true, viewport, deviceScaleFactor}) => {
      const signIn = login && user !== undefined;
      const {use: project} = info.project; // the device's options, not the runner's (trace, timeouts)
      const context = await browser.newContext({
        baseURL: run.url, locale: project.locale, userAgent: project.userAgent, isMobile: project.isMobile, hasTouch: project.hasTouch,
        viewport: viewport ?? project.viewport, deviceScaleFactor: deviceScaleFactor ?? project.deviceScaleFactor,
        storageState: login && !signIn ? project.storageState : undefined,
      });
      context.setDefaultTimeout(project.actionTimeout ?? 10_000);
      context.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(project.navigationTimeout ?? 20_000);
      opened.push(context);
      context.on('weberror', (e) => ignored(info.project.name, String(e.error())) || jsErrors.push(String(e.error())));
      const page = await context.newPage();
      if (signIn) {
        await page.goto('/user/login', {waitUntil: 'load'});
        await page.getByLabel('Username or Email Address').fill(user);
        await page.getByLabel('Password').fill([REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]] ?? '');
        await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Sign In'}).click();
        await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'Sign In'}).waitFor({state: 'hidden'});
      }
      return {...evidence(page, run, name, info), page, user: login ? user ?? run.user : ''};
    });
    for (const c of opened) await c.close();
  },
});

// Signs verify-admin in once per run, through the real login form, and saves the cookie for every spec.
import {existsSync} from 'node:fs';
import {chromium} from '@playwright/test';
import {loadRun, adminState} from './run.ts';

export default async function globalSetup() {
  const run = loadRun();
  const path = adminState(run);
  if (existsSync(path)) return; // a reused run keeps its session
  const browser = await chromium.launch();
  try {
    const page = await browser.newPage({baseURL: run.url});
    await page.goto('/user/login', {waitUntil: 'load'});
    await page.getByLabel('Username or Email Address').fill(run.user);
    await page.getByLabel('Password').fill(run.[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]);
    await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Sign In'}).click();
    await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'Sign In'}).waitFor({state: 'hidden'});
    await page.context().storageState({path});
  } finally {
    await browser.close();
  }
}

**How should screenshots/ARIA evidence and the strict JS-error check survive the conversion?**

Options:
- **Thin verify layer (Recommended)** - Specs use upstream idioms (utils.ts helpers, login(), apiCreate*, small focused test()s, .test.ts). They import {test, expect} from a verify fixtures file that only adds the auto JS-error check and a standalone capture(page, 'name'). Moving one into tests/e2e = change one import, delete capture lines.
- **Pure upstream** - Plain '@playwright/test' + './utils.ts', byte-for-byte copyable. Evidence only from config (screenshot: 'on', trace), one shot per test, no ARIA snapshots, no named PR screenshots. JS errors only via assertNoJsError.
- **Keep current fixtures** - Only rename to .test.ts and swap api()/session() for utils.ts helpers; keep s.capture and session(). Least churn, least copyable.

- **Run upstream + extras** - verify's test also runs the matching tests/e2e file; convert only the parts upstream lacks into verify specs.

// The run that `gitea-verify test` (or `up`) chose, read from its state.json.
import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {dirname, join} from 'node:path';
import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

export const skill = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const runs = join(skill, '../../verify-runs');

export type RunState = {id: string, pid: number, port: number, url: string, user: string, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: string, work: string, artifacts: string, ready: boolean};

export function loadRun(): RunState {
  const id = process.env.GITEA_VERIFY_RUN;
  if (!id) throw new Error('GITEA_VERIFY_RUN is unset: run specs through `gitea-verify test`, or export the id from `gitea-verify up`');
  const run: RunState = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runs, id, 'state.json'), 'utf8'));
  if (!run.ready) throw new Error(`run ${id} is not ready (still starting, or its up failed); see gitea-verify list`);
  return run;
}

export function adminState(run: RunState): string {
  return join(run.work, 'admin-storage.json'); // under work/, so down deletes the session cookie with the DB
}

// features/issue-due-date-filter.md: every ?due= option, counts, link keeping, edges, Group by (#26),
// and the repo PR list, user dashboard /issues + /pulls and org dashboard entry points
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';

type Seed = [title: string, offset: number | null];
type Case = [label: string, val: string, expected: string[]];

test('issue-due-date-filter', async ({page, api, user, s}) => {
  const R = `v-due-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, base = `/repos/${user}/${R}`, web = `/${user}/${R}`;
  // the local calendar date: the verify instance runs in the Mac's zone
  const day = (n: number) => { const d = new Date(Date.now() + n * 864e5); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}T00:00:00Z`; };
  const titles = async () => (await page.locator('#issue-list .list-item-large-title').allInnerTexts()).map((t) => t.trim()).sort();
  // dashboards list every repo on the instance (reruns included), so keep only rows linking into this spec's repo
  const ours = async (repoWeb: string) => (await page.locator('#issue-list .list-item-large-title').evaluateAll((els) => els.map((e) => [e.textContent!.trim(), e.getAttribute('href')!])))
    .filter(([, href]) => href.startsWith(`${repoWeb}/`)).map(([t]) => t).sort();
  const seedPRs = async (b: string, prs: Seed[]) => {
    const repo = await api('GET', b);
    for (const [i, [title, off]] of prs.entries()) {
      await api('POST', `${b}/contents/pr-${i}.txt`, {content: Buffer.from(title).toString('base64'), message: title, new_branch: `pr-${i}`});
      const pr = await api('POST', `${b}/pulls`, {title, head: `pr-${i}`, base: repo.default_branch});
      if (off !== null) await api('POST', `${b}/issues/${pr.number}/deadline`, {due_date: day(off)});
    }
  };
  const pick = async (label: string) => {
    await page.locator('.due-date-filter').click();

  }
  s.note('stored', (await api('GET', `${base}/issues?state=all`)).map((i: {title: string, due_date: string}) => [i.title, i.due_date]));

  await page.locator('.due-date-filter').click();

  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  const cases: Case[] = [
    ['Overdue', 'overdue', ['Overdue one']],
    ['Due today', 'today', ['Due today one']],
    ['Due soon', 'soon', ['Due today one']],
    ['No due date', 'none', ['No date one']],
    ['Has a due date', 'set', ['Due later one', 'Due today one', 'Overdue one']],
  ];
  for (const [label, val, expected] of cases) {
    await pick(label);
    expect(new URL(page.url()).searchParams.get('due')).toBe(val);
    expect(await titles()).toEqual(expected);
    await expect(page.locator('.due-date-filter .active.item')).toHaveText(label);
    await expect(page.locator('.small-menu-items .item').first()).toHaveText(`${expected.length} Open`, {useInnerText: true});

  }
  await expect(page.locator('.small-menu-items .item').nth(1)).toHaveAttribute('href', /due=set/);
  await pick('Due this week'); // yesterday is last week on a Monday, so assert only today's issue
  expect(await titles()).toContain('Due today one');

  await page.goto(`${web}/issues?due=bogus`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  expect(await titles()).toHaveLength(4);
  const m = await api('POST', `${base}/milestones`, {title: 'M'});
  await page.goto(`${web}/milestone/${m.id}?due=overdue`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(page.locator('.due-date-filter')).toHaveCount(0);

  // repo Pull Requests list
  const prs: Seed[] = [['PR overdue', -1], ['PR due later', 10], ['PR no date', null]];
  await seedPRs(base, prs);
  s.note('stored-prs', (await api('GET', `${base}/pulls?state=all`)).map((i: {title: string, due_date: string}) => [i.title, i.due_date]));
  await drive(`${web}/pulls`, [
    ['Overdue', 'overdue', ['PR overdue']],
    ['No due date', 'none', ['PR no date']],
    ['Has a due date', 'set', ['PR due later', 'PR overdue']],

  await expect(page.locator('.small-menu-items .item').nth(1)).toHaveAttribute('href', /due=set/);

  // user dashboard /issues and /pulls: a separate entry point
  await drive('/issues', [
    ['Overdue', 'overdue', ['Overdue one']],
    ['No due date', 'none', ['No date one']],
    ['Has a due date', 'set', ['Due later one', 'Due today one', 'Overdue one']],
  ], web, 'dash-issues');
  await expect(page.locator('.small-menu-items .item').nth(1)).toHaveAttribute('href', /due=set/);
  await drive('/pulls', [

  // org dashboard /org/{org}/issues and /pulls on an org-owned repo
  const O = `v-due-org-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, ob = `/repos/${O}/${R}`;
  await api('POST', '/orgs', {username: O});
  await api('POST', `/orgs/${O}/repos`, {name: R, auto_init: true});

  }

  await drive(`/org/${O}/issues`, [

// features/milestone-burndown.md: chart, summary, changes, PR toggle, collapse, done/closed/empty/no-due states
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';

type Point = {date: string, remaining: number, scope: number};

test('milestone-burndown', async ({page, api, user, s}) => {
  const R = `v-burn-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, base = `/repos/${user}/${R}`, web = `/${user}/${R}`;
  const dueOn = new Date(Date.now() + 7 * 864e5).toISOString();
  const chart = page.locator('#milestone-burndown-chart');
  const summary = chart.locator('.milestone-burndown-summary');
  const counts = (points: Point[]) => points.map(({remaining, scope}) => ({remaining, scope}));
  const openMilestone = async (id: number, query = '') => {
    const [r] = await Promise.all([
      page.waitForResponse((res) => res.url().includes(`/milestone/${id}/burndown${query}`)),
      page.goto(`${web}/milestone/${id}`, {waitUntil: 'load'}),
    ]);
    return r.json();
  };

  await api('POST', '/user/repos', {name: R, auto_init: true});
  const m = await api('POST', `${base}/milestones`, {title: 'M1', due_on: dueOn});
  for (const t of ['A', 'B', 'C']) await api('POST', `${base}/issues`, {title: t, milestone: m.id});
  await api('PATCH', `${base}/issues/1`, {state: 'closed'});
  await api('POST', `${base}/contents/x.txt`, {content: Buffer.from('x').toString('base64'), branch: 'main', new_branch: 'feat'});
  await api('POST', `${base}/pulls`, {head: 'feat', base: 'main', title: 'P', milestone: m.id});

  const j1 = await openMilestone(m.id);
  s.note('burndown', j1);
  expect(j1.status).toBe('insufficient_data');
  expect(counts(j1.points)).toEqual([{remaining: 2, scope: 3}]);
  await expect(chart.locator('canvas')).toBeVisible();
  await expect(summary).toHaveText('A projected finish date appears after two days of history');
  await expect(chart.locator('canvas')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', (await summary.textContent())!.trim());
  await expect(chart.locator('.milestone-burndown-changes')).toContainText(`Changes on ${j1.points[0].date}`);
  await expect(chart.locator('.milestone-burndown-changes')).toContainText('Closed: #1 A');
  await s.capture('before-toggle');

  const toggle = chart.getByRole('checkbox', {name: 'Include pull requests'});
  await expect(toggle).not.toBeChecked();
  const [r2] = await Promise.all([page.waitForResponse((res) => res.url().includes('burndown?include_pulls=1')), toggle.check()]);
  const j2 = await r2.json();
  s.note('burndown-pulls', j2);
  expect(counts(j2.points)).toEqual([{remaining: 3, scope: 4}]);
  expect(page.url()).toContain('include_pulls=1');
  await page.reload({waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(chart.getByRole('checkbox', {name: 'Include pull requests'})).toBeChecked();
  await s.capture('after-toggle');
  await chart.locator('summary').first().click();
  await expect(chart.locator('canvas')).toBeHidden();

  const done = await api('POST', `${base}/milestones`, {title: 'Done', due_on: dueOn});
  for (const t of ['D1', 'D2']) {
    const i = await api('POST', `${base}/issues`, {title: t, milestone: done.id});
    await api('PATCH', `${base}/issues/${i.number}`, {state: 'closed'});
  }
  const jd = await openMilestone(done.id);
  await expect(summary).toHaveText(`Completed on ${jd.points[0].date}`);
  await s.capture('done');

  const closed = await api('POST', `${base}/milestones`, {title: 'Closed', due_on: dueOn});
  await api('POST', `${base}/issues`, {title: 'Still open', milestone: closed.id});
  await api('PATCH', `${base}/milestones/${closed.id}`, {state: 'closed', due_on: dueOn}); // without due_on the PATCH clears it
  await openMilestone(closed.id);
  await expect(summary).toHaveText('Milestone closed with open items');

  const noDue = await api('POST', `${base}/milestones`, {title: 'NoDue'});
  await api('POST', `${base}/issues`, {title: 'ND', milestone: noDue.id});
  await openMilestone(noDue.id);
  await expect(summary).toHaveText('A projected finish date appears after two days of history · Set a due date to see the ideal line');
  await expect(chart.locator('canvas')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'A projected finish date appears after two days of history');

  const empty = await api('POST', `${base}/milestones`, {title: 'Empty'});
  await page.goto(`${web}/milestone/${empty.id}`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(chart).toContainText('This milestone has no issues or pull requests yet.');
  await expect(chart.locator('canvas')).toHaveCount(0);
  await s.capture('empty');
});

// features/multiselect-aria.md: label, assignee, reviewer and project pickers (combobox state, live announcements, focus),
// topics editor, branch-protection user and team pickers (aria state, announcements, delete-icon names)
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';

test('multiselect-aria', async ({page, api, user, s}) => {
  const R = `v-ms-${Date.now().toString(36)}`, base = `/repos/${user}/${R}`;
  const live = page.locator('body > [role="status"]');
  const tag = Date.now().toString(36), PW = `Pw-${tag}-x9`;
  const C1 = `v-ms-a-${tag}`, C2 = `v-ms-b-${tag}`, O = `v-ms-org-${tag}`, PROJ = `Roadmap ${tag}`;

  // the label picker's contract on another issue-sidebar picker; aria-expanded is left out (known bug #104)
  const sidebarPick = async (field: string, option: string, what: string) => {
    const combo = `.issue-sidebar-combo:has(input[name="${field}"])`;
    const dd = page.locator(`${combo} > .ui.dropdown`);
    const item = dd.locator('.scrolling.menu > .item', {hasText: option});
    await expect(dd).toHaveAttribute('role', 'combobox');
    await dd.focus(); // opens the menu
    await expect(dd.locator('> .menu')).toHaveAttribute('aria-multiselectable', 'true');
    await expect(item).toHaveAttribute('role', 'option');
    await expect(item).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    const presses = await dd.evaluate((el, opt) => {
      const items = [...el.querySelectorAll('.scrolling.menu > .item:not(.filtered, .tw-hidden)')];
      return items.findIndex((i) => i.textContent!.includes(opt)) - items.findIndex((i) => i.classList.contains('selected'));
    }, option);
    for (let i = 0; i < presses; i++) await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(item).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(live).toHaveText(`Selected "${option}"`);
    await expect(dd).toBeFocused();
    await s.capture(what);
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); // closing saves
    await expect(page.locator(`${combo} .ui.list`)).toContainText(option);
  };

  await api('POST', '/user/repos', {name: R, auto_init: true});
  for (const name of ['bug', 'docs']) await api('POST', `${base}/labels`, {name, color: '#ee0701'});
  await api('POST', `${base}/issues`, {title: 'labels'});
  await api('PUT', `${base}/topics`, {topics: ['alpha']});
  for (const u of [C1, C2]) await api('POST', '/admin/users', {username: u, email: `${u}@example.com`, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: PW, must_change_[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: false});
  await api('PUT', `${base}/collaborators/${C1}`, {permission: 'write'});
  const {default_branch: main} = await api('GET', base);
  await api('POST', `${base}/contents/feature.txt`, {content: Buffer.from('x\n').toString('base64'), new_branch: 'feature'});
  await api('POST', `${base}/pulls`, {head: 'feature', base: main, title: 'reviewers'}); // #2

  await page.goto(`/${user}/${R}/issues/1`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  const picker = page.locator('.issue-sidebar-combo:has(input[name="label_ids"]) > .ui.dropdown');
  const bug = picker.locator('.scrolling.menu > .item', {hasText: 'bug'});
  await expect(picker).toHaveAttribute('role', 'combobox');
  await picker.focus(); // opens the menu
  await expect(picker.locator('> .menu')).toHaveAttribute('aria-multiselectable', 'true');
  await expect(bug).toHaveAttribute('role', 'option');
  await expect(bug).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
  const presses = await picker.evaluate((el) => {
    const items = [...el.querySelectorAll('.scrolling.menu > .item:not(.filtered, .tw-hidden)')];
    return items.findIndex((i) => i.textContent!.includes('bug')) - items.findIndex((i) => i.classList.contains('selected'));
  });
  for (let i = 0; i < presses; i++) await page.keyboard.press('ArrowDown');

  await expect(live).toHaveText('Selected "bug"');
  await expect(picker).toBeFocused();
  await s.capture('label-selected');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape'); // closing saves
  await expect(page.locator('.issue-sidebar-combo:has(input[name="label_ids"]) .ui.list')).toContainText('bug');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await api('GET', `${base}/issues/1`)).labels.map((l: {name: string}) => l.name)).toEqual(['bug']);

  // assignees, then projects on the issue; reviewers on the PR
  await page.goto(`/${user}/${R}/issues/1`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await sidebarPick('assignee_ids', C1, 'assignee-selected');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await api('GET', `${base}/issues/1`)).assignees?.map((a: {login: string}) => a.login)).toEqual([C1]);

  await page.goto(`/${user}/${R}/projects/new`, {waitUntil: 'load'}); // no project API: seed through the form
  await page.locator('input[name="title"]').fill(PROJ);
  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Create Project'}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.milestone-list a', {hasText: PROJ}).first()).toBeVisible();
  await page.goto(`/${user}/${R}/issues/1`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await sidebarPick('project_ids', PROJ, 'project-selected');
  await page.reload({waitUntil: 'load'}); // stored, not only redrawn
  await expect(page.locator('.sidebar-project-combo .issue-sidebar-project-cards')).toContainText(PROJ);

  await page.goto(`/${user}/${R}/pulls/2`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await sidebarPick('reviewer_ids', C1, 'reviewer-selected');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await api('GET', `${base}/pulls/2`)).requested_reviewers?.map((r: {login: string}) => r.login)).toEqual([C1]);

  await page.goto(`/${user}/${R}`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await page.locator('#manage_topic').click();
  await expect(page.locator('#topic_edit .ui.label .delete.icon')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', 'Remove item "alpha"');
  await page.keyboard.type('beta');

  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');

  await expect(page.locator('#repo-topics')).toContainText('alpha');
  await expect.poll(async () => (await api('GET', `${base}/topics`)).topics).toEqual(['alpha']);

  // branch-protection user and team pickers: an org repo with a team, a rule seeded with C1 and team alpha
  await api('POST', '/orgs', {username: O});
  const {default_branch: obr} = await api('POST', `/orgs/${O}/repos`, {name: R, auto_init: true});
  for (const t of ['alpha', 'beta']) await api('POST', `/orgs/${O}/teams`, {name: t, permission: 'write', includes_all_repositories: true, units: ['repo.code', 'repo.pulls']});
  for (const u of [C1, C2]) await api('PUT', `/repos/${O}/${R}/collaborators/${u}`, {permission: 'write'});
  await api('POST', `/repos/${O}/${R}/branch_protections`, {rule_name: obr, enable_push: true, enable_push_whitelist: true, push_whitelist_usernames: [C1], push_whitelist_teams: ['alpha']});
  await page.goto(`/${O}/${R}/settings/branches/edit?rule_name=${obr}`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  const bpPick = async (field: string, preset: string, added: string) => {
    const dd = page.locator(`.ui.dropdown:has(> input[name="${field}"])`);
    const search = dd.locator('input.search');
    const opt = (t: string) => dd.locator('> .menu > .item', {hasText: t});
    await expect(search).toHaveAttribute('role', 'combobox');
    await expect(dd.locator('> .menu')).toHaveAttribute('aria-multiselectable', 'true');
    await expect(opt(preset)).toHaveAttribute('role', 'option');
    await expect(opt(preset)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(opt(added)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
    await expect(dd.locator('.ui.label', {hasText: preset}).locator('.delete.icon')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', `Remove item "${preset}"`); // the name, not the ID value
    await search.focus();
    await page.keyboard.type(added);
    await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
    await expect(opt(added)).toHaveAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');
    await expect(live).toHaveText(`Selected "${added}"`); // the preset is not announced
    await expect(search).toBeFocused();
    await expect(dd.locator('.ui.label', {hasText: added}).locator('.delete.icon')).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', `Remove item "${added}"`);
    return {dd, search, opt};
  };
  await bpPick('whitelist_users', C1, C2);
  const teams = await bpPick('whitelist_teams', 'alpha', 'beta');

  await expect(live).toHaveText('Deselected "beta"');

  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Save Rule'}).click();

test('notifications', async ({api, session}) => {

  await api('POST', `/repos/${U}/r2/issues`, {title: 'r2 one'});

  await api('POST', `/repos/${U}/r2/pulls`, {head: 'feat', base: 'main', title: 'r2 pr'});

  const s = await session({name: 'notifications', user: U, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: PW});
  const {page} = s;
  const rows = page.locator('#notification_table .notifications-item');
  const repoFilter = page.locator('[data-test-id="notification-filter-repo"]');
  const typeFilter = page.locator('[data-test-id="notification-filter-type"]');
  const bulk = page.locator('.notification-bulk-actions');

  await expect(async () => { // a background queue writes notifications
    await page.goto('/notifications', {waitUntil: 'load'});
    await expect(rows).toHaveCount(4, {timeout: 500});
  }).toPass({timeout: 15000});
  await s.capture('all');

  await repoFilter.click();
  await expect(repoFilter.locator('.menu .item')).toHaveText(['All repositories', `${U}/r1`, `${U}/r2`]);

// features/org-require-2fa.md: self-required refusal, enable, banner, blocked access, API 403, compliance, enrol, last factor
import {createHmac, randomBytes} from 'node:crypto';
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';
import type {Page} from '../fixtures.ts';

const POLICY = 'Require two-factor authentication for members and outside collaborators';

const totp = (b32: string) => { // RFC 6238: SHA1, 6 digits, 30 s
  const alphabet = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567';
  let bits = '';
  for (const c of b32.replace(/=+$/, '').toUpperCase()) bits += alphabet.indexOf(c).toString(2).padStart(5, '0');
  const key = Buffer.from(bits.match(/.{8}/g)!.map((b) => parseInt(b, 2)));
  const counter = Buffer.alloc(8);
  counter.writeBigUInt64BE(BigInt(Math.floor(Date.now() / 30000)));
  const h = createHmac('sha1', key).update(counter).digest();
  return String((h.readUInt32BE(h[19] & 15) & 0x7fffffff) % 1e6).padStart(6, '0');
};

const savePolicy = async (page: Page) => {
  await page.getByRole('checkbox', {name: POLICY}).check();
  await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent('load'), page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Update Settings'}).first().click()]);
};

test('org-require-2fa', async ({api, session}) => {

  for (const u of [U, C]) await api('POST', '/admin/users', {username: u, email: `${u}@example.com`, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: PW, must_change_[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: false});
  await api('POST', '/orgs', {username: O});
  await api('POST', '/orgs', {username: O2});
  await api('POST', `/orgs/${O}/repos`, {name: 'priv', private: true, auto_init: true});
  await api('POST', `/orgs/${O}/repos`, {name: 'pub', auto_init: true});
  const team = await api('POST', `/orgs/${O}/teams`, {name: 'writers', permission: 'write', includes_all_repositories: true, units: ['repo.code']});
  await api('PUT', `/teams/${team.id}/members/${U}`);
  await api('PUT', `/repos/${O}/priv/collaborators/${C}`, {permission: 'read'});
  const owners2 = (await api('GET', `/orgs/${O2}/teams`)).find((t: {name: string}) => t.name === 'Owners');
  await api('PUT', `/teams/${owners2.id}/members/${U}`); // U: a non-admin owner of O2

  const a = await session({name: 'org-2fa-owner'});
  const m = await session({name: 'org-2fa-member', user: U, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: PW});
  const [ap, mp] = [a.page, m.page];

  expect((await mp.goto(`/${O}/priv`))!.status()).toBe(200);
  await mp.goto('/');
  await expect(mp.locator('.flash-error')).toHaveCount(0);
  await m.capture('before');

  await mp.goto(`/org/${O2}/settings`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await savePolicy(mp);
  await expect(mp.locator('.flash-error')).toContainText('Set up two-factor authentication on your own account before requiring it');
  await m.capture('self-required-refused');

  await ap.goto(`/org/${O}/settings`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(ap.locator('#security_box')).toContainText('1 members and 1 outside collaborators');
  await savePolicy(ap);
  await expect(ap.locator('.flash-success')).toContainText('Organization settings have been updated.');
  await expect(ap.getByRole('checkbox', {name: POLICY})).toBeChecked();
  await a.capture('settings-after');

  await mp.goto('/', {waitUntil: 'load'});
  const banner = mp.locator('.flash-error a');
  await expect(banner).toContainText('An organization you belong to requires two-factor authentication');
  await expect(banner).toHaveAttribute('href', '/user/settings/security/two_factor/enroll');
  expect((await mp.goto(`/${O}/priv`))!.status()).toBe(404);
  expect((await mp.goto(`/org/${O}/teams`))!.status()).toBe(404);
  expect((await mp.goto(`/org/${O}/members`))!.status()).toBe(200); // the public view
  expect((await mp.goto(`/${O}/pub`))!.status()).toBe(200);
  await m.capture('blocked');
  const denied = await api('GET', `/orgs/${O}/teams?sudo=${U}`).then(() => 'allowed', (e: unknown) => String(e));
  expect(denied).toMatch(/403.*requires two-factor authentication/);
  m.note('api-403', {denied});

  await ap.goto(`/org/${O}/members`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(ap.locator('.ui.warning.message')).toContainText('Members without it: 1.');
  await expect(ap.getByText('No access until 2FA is set up')).toHaveCount(1);
  await expect(ap.locator('.flash-error')).toHaveCount(0); // admins are exempt
  await a.capture('members');
  await ap.goto(`/${O}/priv/settings/collaboration`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(ap.getByText('No access until 2FA is set up')).toHaveCount(1);

  await mp.goto('/user/settings/security/two_factor/enroll', {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(mp.locator('.flash-error')).toHaveCount(0);
  const secret = (await mp.getByText(/Or enter the secret:/).textContent())!.split(':').pop()!.trim();
  await mp.getByLabel('Passcode').fill(totp(secret));
  await Promise.all([mp.waitForEvent('load'), mp.getByRole('button', {name: 'Verify'}).click()]);
  expect((await mp.goto(`/${O}/priv`))!.status()).toBe(200);
  await mp.goto('/', {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(mp.locator('.flash-error')).toHaveCount(0);
  await m.capture('enrolled');

  await ap.goto(`/org/${O2}/settings`, {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await savePolicy(ap);
  await mp.goto('/user/settings/security', {waitUntil: 'load'});
  await mp.getByRole('button', {name: 'Disable Two-Factor Authentication'}).click();
  await mp.locator('.ui.modal.visible').getByRole('button', {name: 'Yes'}).click(); // a copy of #disable-twofa, minus the id
  await expect(mp.locator('.flash-error')).toContainText(`You own an organization that requires two-factor authentication (${O2})`);
  await m.capture('last-factor-refused');
  await mp.reload({waitUntil: 'load'});
  await expect(mp.getByRole('button', {name: 'Disable Two-Factor Authentication'})).toBeVisible(); // the factor survived
});

async function createRepo(page: Page) {
  const repoName = `e2e-shortcut-${randomString(8)}`;
  await apiCreateRepo(page.request, {name: repoName});

  return `/${env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_USER}/${repoName}`;

// presses a shortcut that leaves the page, and waits until the next page can take one
async function goWith(page: Page, keys: string, url: RegExp) {

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(url);
  await page.waitForLoadState();
}

// resolveSpecs maps each arg to a spec file: a path from the caller's cwd, or a saved feature name.
// Specs outside specs/ (scratchpad ones) must share a directory, which becomes Playwright's testDir.
func resolveSpecs(args []string, cwd string) (files []string, testDir string, err error) {
	for _, a := range args {
		p := a
		if !filepath.IsAbs(p) {
			p = filepath.Join(cwd, a)
		}
		if st, e := os.Stat(p); e == nil && st.Mode().IsRegular() {
			files = append(files, p)
			continue
		}
		if named := filepath.Join(P.Specs, a+".spec.ts"); filepath.Base(a) == a && exists(named) {
			files = append(files, named)
			continue
		}
		return nil, "", verifyErr("no spec '%s' (have: %s)", a, strings.Join(specNames(), " "))
	}
	saved := false
	for _, f := range files {
		if dir := filepath.Dir(f); dir == P.Specs {
			saved = true
		} else if testDir == "" {
			testDir = dir
		} else if dir != testDir {
			return nil, "", verifyErr("specs outside specs/ must share one directory; got %s and %s", testDir, dir)
		}
	}
	if saved && testDir != "" {
		return nil, "", verifyErr("can't mix saved specs with specs from %s in one run", testDir)
	}
	return files, testDir, nil
}

func specNames() []string {
	m, _ := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(P.Specs, "*.spec.ts"))
	for i, f := range m {
		m[i] = strings.TrimSuffix(filepath.Base(f), ".spec.ts")
	}
	return m
}

// cmdTest runs Playwright on $GITEA_VERIFY_RUN when doctor passes, else on a fresh run it always tears down.
func cmdTest(specs, extra []string) (int, error) {
	cwd, err := os.Getwd()
	if err != nil {
		return 1, err
	}
	var files []string
	testDir := ""
	if !slices.Equal(specs, []string{"--all"}) {
		if files, testDir, err = resolveSpecs(specs, cwd); err != nil {
			return 1, err
		}
	}
	if testDir != "" { // Playwright loads a spec as ESM only under a "type": "module" package.json, and fixtures.ts is ESM
		if pkg := filepath.Join(testDir, "package.json"); !exists(pkg) {
			if err := os.WriteFile(pkg, []byte(`{"type": "module"}`+"\n"), 0o644); err != nil {
				return 1, err
			}
			say("wrote %s so Playwright loads these specs as ES modules", pkg)
		}
	}
	var run Run
	fresh := false
	if reuse := os.Getenv("GITEA_VERIFY_RUN"); reuse != "" {
		if r, err := load(reuse); err == nil && !cmdDoctor(r).Failed() {
			run = r
			say("reusing run %s", r.ID)
		} else {
			warn("GITEA_VERIFY_RUN=%s is not a healthy run; starting a fresh one", reuse)
		}
	}
	if run.ID == "" {
		if run, err = cmdUp(os.Getpid()); err != nil {
			return 1, err
		}
		fresh = true
		say("started run %s", run.ID)
	}
	if fresh {
		defer func() { _ = cmdDown(run.ID) }() // a fresh instance never outlives this command
	}
	report := cmdDoctor(run)
	report.Print()
	if report.Failed() {
		return 1, verifyErr("doctor failed before driving")
	}
	args := []string{"exec", P.Repo, "pnpm", "exec", "playwright", "test", "-c", filepath.Join(P.Skill, "playwright.config.ts")}
	for _, f := range files {
		args = append(args, regexpQuote(f)) // Playwright reads each filter as a regex over the file path
	}
	if !slices.ContainsFunc(extra, func(a string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(a, "--project") }) {
		args = append(args, "--project=chromium") // webkit only when asked: -- --project=webkit
	}
	pw := exec.Command("direnv", append(args, extra...)...)
	pw.Dir, pw.Stdin, pw.Stdout, pw.Stderr = P.Repo, nil, os.Stdout, os.Stderr
	pw.Env = append(os.Environ(), "GITEA_VERIFY_RUN="+run.ID, "GITEA_VERIFY_OWNER="+strconv.Itoa(os.Getpid()), "GV_SPECS="+testDir)
	pw.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{Setpgid: true} // own group: only we pass signals on, and to all of it
	code, err := runGroup(pw)
	say("artifacts: %s", run.Artifacts)
	say("report: pnpm exec playwright show-report %s/report", run.Artifacts)
	for _, s := range report.Stale() {
		say("stale build, results may not reflect your change: %s", s)
	}

// Playwright's test with verify's one addition: any uncaught page error fails the test. Specs are written in the
// tests/e2e style, so moving one upstream means importing test from '@playwright/test' and dropping evidence calls.
// Scratchpad specs import this by absolute path:
//   import {test, expect} from '/Users/everick/Projects/CSCI435/gitea/.claude/skills/verify/fixtures.ts';
import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {test as base, expect} from '@playwright/test';
import type {BrowserContext} from '@playwright/test';
import {evidenceDir} from './evidence.ts';

export {expect};

// under `gitea-verify test`: exit once the runner is gone (even SIGKILLed), so no worker drives a dead server
const owner = Number(process.env.GITEA_VERIFY_OWNER);
if (owner) {
  setInterval(() => {
    try { process.kill(owner, 0); } catch { process.exit(137); } // Playwright closes its browsers on exit
  }, 1000).unref();
}

// WebKit rejects a fetch still in flight when the page navigates away ("Load failed"); Chromium drops it silently
const ignored = (browser: string, e: string) => browser === 'webkit' && e === 'Unhandled Promise Rejection: TypeError: Load failed';

export const test = base.extend<{jsErrors: string[]}>({
  // a proof with uncaught page errors is not a proof: fails the test after it ends, in every context it opened
  jsErrors: [async ({browser}, use, info) => {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const watched = new WeakSet<BrowserContext>();
    const watch = (c: BrowserContext) => {
      if (watched.has(c)) return;
      watched.add(c);
      c.on('weberror', (e) => ignored(info.project.name, String(e.error())) || errors.push(String(e.error())));
    };
    const newContext = browser.newContext.bind(browser);
    browser.newContext = async (opts) => { const c = await newContext(opts); watch(c); return c }; // specs' second accounts
    for (const c of browser.contexts()) watch(c);
    try {
      await use(errors);
    } finally {
      browser.newContext = newContext;
    }
    writeFileSync(join(evidenceDir(info), 'js-errors.json'), JSON.stringify(errors, null, 2));
    expect(errors, 'uncaught page errors').toEqual([]);
  }, {auto: true}],
  context: async ({context, jsErrors}, use, info) => {
    context.on('weberror', (e) => ignored(info.project.name, String(e.error())) || jsErrors.push(String(e.error())));
    await use(context);
  },
});

// Evidence for verify runs: screenshots, ARIA snapshots and API state under artifacts/<spec>/<test>/.
// Upstream tests/e2e has no equivalent, so delete these calls when moving a spec there.
import {mkdirSync, writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';
import {basename, join} from 'node:path';
import {test} from '@playwright/test';
import type {Page, TestInfo} from '@playwright/test';
import {loadRun} from './run.ts';

const steps = new Map<string, number>();

const slug = (s: string) => s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-|-$/g, '').slice(0, 60);

/** artifacts/<spec>/<test>/, the spec suffixed with the browser when it isn't chromium so a webkit run keeps its own */
export function evidenceDir(info: TestInfo): string {
  const spec = basename(info.file).replace(/\.test\.ts$/, '');
  const dir = join(loadRun().artifacts, info.project.name === 'chromium' ? spec : `${spec}-${info.project.name}`, slug(info.title));
  mkdirSync(dir, {recursive: true});
  return dir;
}

function label(dir: string, what: string): string {
  const n = (steps.get(dir) ?? 0) + 1;
  steps.set(dir, n);
  return join(dir, `${String(n).padStart(2, '0')}-${what}`);
}

/** a full-page screenshot plus an ARIA snapshot of the same moment, numbered in capture order */
export async function capture(page: Page, what: string): Promise<string> {
  const info = test.info();
  const file = label(evidenceDir(info), what);
  await page.screenshot({path: `${file}.png`, fullPage: true});
  writeFileSync(`${file}.aria.yml`, await page.locator('body').ariaSnapshot());
  await info.attach(basename(file), {path: `${file}.png`, contentType: 'image/png'});
  return file;
}

/** stored state read back through the API, as NN-<what>.json */
export function note(what: string, data: unknown): void {
  writeFileSync(`${label(evidenceDir(test.info()), what)}.json`, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
}

// Playwright config for the verify specs; `gitea-verify test` runs it against one shared instance.
// Timeouts and env match the repo's playwright.config.ts and tools/test-e2e.sh, so a spec that passes here fits upstream.
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {defineConfig, devices} from '@playwright/test';
import {loadRun, skill} from './run.ts';

const run = loadRun();

// what tests/e2e/utils.ts reads; workers load this config too, so they inherit it
process.env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_URL = run.url;
process.env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_USER = run.user;
process.env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_PASSWORD = run.[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]];
process.env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_DOMAIN = 'verify.test';
process.env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_EMAIL = `${run.user}@verify.test`;

const timeoutFactor = Number(process.env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_TIMEOUT_FACTOR) || 1;
const timeout = 5000 * timeoutFactor;

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: process.env.GV_SPECS || join(skill, 'specs'), // gitea-verify sets it for scratchpad specs
  testMatch: /.*\.test\.ts$/,
  outputDir: join(run.artifacts, 'playwright'),
  workers: 4, // one instance, so specs seed uniquely named state
  fullyParallel: true,
  retries: 0, // a proof that passes on retry is not a proof
  timeout: 2 * timeout,
  expect: {timeout},
  reporter: [['list'], ['html', {open: 'never', outputFolder: join(run.artifacts, 'report')}]],
  use: {
    baseURL: run.url,
    locale: 'en-US',
    actionTimeout: timeout,
    navigationTimeout: 2 * timeout,
    trace: 'retain-on-failure',
  },
  projects: [ // firefox hangs at launch on this Mac; CI covers it

// features/aria-menu.md: devtest demo, navbar, footer language picker, comment More Operations, footer Theme name (#64)
import {env} from 'node:process';
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';
import type {Locator, Page} from '@playwright/test';
import {capture} from '../evidence.ts';
import {apiCreateIssue, apiCreateRepo, login, randomString} from './utils.ts';

const isFocused = (l: Locator) => expect.poll(() => l.evaluate((el) => el === document.activeElement)).toBe(true);
const menuOf = (page: Page, trigger: Locator) => page.locator('aria-menu', {has: trigger}).getByRole('menu');

test('devtest menus open by keyboard, pick by mouse and place themselves', async ({page}) => {
  await page.goto('/devtest/aria-menu');
  const text = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Text items'});
  await text.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(text).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Apple'}));
  await capture(page, 'demo-open');
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Grape'}));
  await page.keyboard.press('b');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Banana'}));
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await isFocused(text);
  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowUp');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Grape'}));
  await page.keyboard.press(' ');
  await expect(page.locator('#devtest-aria-menu-output')).toHaveText('Grape');
  await expect(text).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'With a divider and header'}).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Stars'}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('#devtest-aria-menu-output')).toHaveText('Stars');

  const more = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'More actions'});
  await more.click();
  const [tb, mb] = [(await more.boundingBox())!, (await menuOf(page, more).boundingBox())!];
  expect(Math.abs((tb.x + tb.width) - (mb.x + mb.width))).toBeLessThan(5); // bottom-end
  await page.locator('h1').first().click(); // outside click closes
  await expect(menuOf(page, more)).toBeHidden();
  const up = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Opens upward'});
  await up.click();
  const [ub, upb] = [(await up.boundingBox())!, (await menuOf(page, up).boundingBox())!];
  expect(upb.y + upb.height).toBeLessThanOrEqual(ub.y + 1); // top-start
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
});

test('navbar profile and create menus are keyboard operable', async ({page}) => {
  await login(page);
  await page.goto('/');
  const profile = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Profile and Settings…'});
  await profile.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Profile', exact: true}));
  await expect(page.getByRole('menu', {name: 'Profile and Settings…'})).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Site Administration'})).toBeVisible();
  await page.keyboard.press('End');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Sign Out'}));
  await capture(page, 'navbar-profile');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  const create = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Create…'});
  await create.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'New Repository'}));
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
});

test('footer language menu marks the current language, and the theme menu is named', async ({page}) => {
  await page.goto('/');
  const lang = page.locator('aria-menu:has(.language-menu) > button'); // named after the current language
  await expect(lang).toHaveText('English');
  await lang.focus();
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter'); // never activate an item: it switches the UI language
  await expect(page.locator('.language-menu .item.selected')).toHaveText('English');
  await capture(page, 'footer-language');
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await isFocused(lang);
  await expect(page.getByRole('menu', {name: 'Theme'})).toHaveCount(1); // #64
});

test('comment More Operations menu takes type-ahead and quotes the comment', async ({page, request}) => {
  const repo = `e2e-aria-menu-${randomString(8)}`;

  const ops = page.getByRole('button', {name: 'More Operations'}).first();

  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Copy Link'}));
  await expect(menuOf(page, ops).getByRole('menuitem')).toHaveText(['Copy Link', 'Copy Source', 'Quote Reply', 'Reference in New Issue', 'Edit']);
  await capture(page, 'comment-menu');
  await page.keyboard.press('q');
  await isFocused(page.getByRole('menuitem', {name: 'Quote Reply'}));
  await page.keyboard.press('Enter');
  await expect(ops).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

  await capture(page, 'quoted');
});

// features/sign-in.md: navbar entry, bad [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]], redirect_to round trip, remember-me, sign-out in every tab, direct /user/login to dashboard
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';
import type {APIRequestContext, Page} from '@playwright/test';
import {capture, note} from '../evidence.ts';
import {apiCreateUser, apiHeaders, baseUrl, loginUser, randomString} from './utils.ts';

const [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]] = `Pw-${randomString(12)}`;

// utils.ts keeps its shared [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]] private, and these tests type one into the form
async function createUser(request: APIRequestContext) {
  const username = `e2e-signin-${randomString(8)}`;
  const response = await request.post(`${baseUrl()}/api/v1/admin/users`, {
    headers: apiHeaders(),
    data: {username, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]], email: `${username}@example.com`, must_change_[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]: false},
  });
  expect(response.ok()).toBe(true);
  return username;
}

async function fillLogin(page: Page, username: string, pw: string) {
  await page.getByLabel('Username or Email Address').fill(username);
  await page.getByLabel('Password').fill(pw);
}

test('a wrong [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]] keeps the user on the form with the name filled in', async ({page, request}) => {
  const username = await createUser(request);
  await page.goto('/');
  await page.getByRole('link', {name: 'Sign In'}).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/user\/login$/);
  await fillLogin(page, username, 'wrong-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]');
  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Sign In'}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.flash-error')).toContainText('Username or [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]] is incorrect.');
  expect(new URL(page.url()).pathname).toBe('/user/login');
  await expect(page.getByLabel('Username or Email Address')).toHaveValue(username);
  await capture(page, 'bad-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]');
});

test('signing in from a protected page returns to it and remembers the device', async ({page, request}) => {
  const username = await createUser(request);
  await page.goto('/user/settings');
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/user\/login\?redirect_to=%2Fuser%2Fsettings$/);
  await fillLogin(page, username, [REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-[REDACTED:generic-password]]]);
  await page.getByText('Remember This Device').click();
  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Sign In'}).click();

  await capture(page, 'signed-in-redirected');
});

test('signing out in one tab signs out every tab', async ({page, request}) => {

});

// features/issue-comment-close.md: comment, every close reason, reopen, bulk close, PR reasons
import {env} from 'node:process';
import {test, expect} from '../fixtures.ts';
import type {APIRequestContext, Page} from '@playwright/test';
import {capture} from '../evidence.ts';
import {apiCreateFile, apiCreateIssue, apiCreatePR, apiCreateRepo, apiHeaders, baseUrl, login, randomString} from './utils.ts';

const owner = env.GITEA_TEST_E2E_USER;

async function apiGet(request: APIRequestContext, path: string) {
  const response = await request.get(`${baseUrl()}/api/v1${path}`, {headers: apiHeaders()});
  expect(response.ok()).toBe(true);
  return response.json();
}

// a repo with issues titled as given, numbered from 1
async function seed(page: Page, titles: string[]) {
  const repo = `e2e-close-${randomString(8)}`;
  await Promise.all([apiCreateRepo(page.request, {name: repo}), login(page)]);
  for (const title of titles) await apiCreateIssue(page.request, {owner, repo, title});
  return repo;
}

const reasonMenu = (page: Page) => page.locator('#comment-form').getByLabel('Choose a close reason');
const reasonItems = (page: Page) => reasonMenu(page).locator('.menu .item'); // #comment-form's editor tabs are .menu .item too
async function pickReason(page: Page, reason: string) {
  await reasonMenu(page).click();
  await reasonItems(page).filter({hasText: reason}).click();
}

test('a comment posts, then the issue closes as completed and reopens', async ({page}) => {
  const repo = await seed(page, ['Verify comment flow', 'Dup target']);
  const issue = () => apiGet(page.request, `/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/1`);
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/issues/1`);
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', {level: 1})).toContainText('Verify comment flow #1');
  await capture(page, 'before');
  const body = 'hello from verify';
  await page.getByPlaceholder('Leave a comment').fill(body);
  await expect(page.locator('#status-button')).toHaveText('Close as completed with comment');
  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Comment', exact: true}).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.comment-body').filter({hasText: body})).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Comment', exact: true})).toBeDisabled();
  await capture(page, 'commented');

  await reasonMenu(page).click();
  await expect(reasonItems(page)).toHaveText(['Completed', 'Not planned', 'Duplicate', 'Other']);
  await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
  await pickReason(page, 'Duplicate');
  await page.locator('#close-duplicate-index').fill('2');
  await expect(page.locator('#status-button')).toHaveText('Close as duplicate of #2'); // after the debounced lookup
  await capture(page, 'duplicate-popup');
  await pickReason(page, 'Completed');
  await page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Close as completed'}).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Reopen Issue'})).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('.issue-state-label')).toContainText('Closed as completed');
  await capture(page, 'closed');
  expect(await issue()).toMatchObject({state: 'closed', close_reason: 'completed'});
  expect((await apiGet(page.request, `/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/1/comments`)).map((c: {body: string}) => c.body)).toContain(body);
  await Promise.all([page.waitForEvent('load'), page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Reopen Issue'}).click()]);
  expect(await issue()).toMatchObject({state: 'open', close_reason: ''});

  await page.setViewportSize({width: 360, height: 800}); // the close-reason menu once overlapped Comment here
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/issues/1`);
  await capture(page, 'narrow');
});

test('closing as a duplicate records and links the original', async ({page}) => {
  const repo = await seed(page, ['Original', 'Copy']);
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/issues/2`);
  await pickReason(page, 'Duplicate');
  await page.locator('#close-duplicate-index').fill('1');
  await expect(page.locator('#status-button')).toHaveText('Close as duplicate of #1');
  await page.locator('#status-button').click();
  await expect(page.locator('.issue-state-label')).toContainText('Closed as duplicate');
  await expect(page.locator('.timeline-item.event').last()).toContainText(/closed this as a duplicate\s+#1 Original/, {useInnerText: true});
  expect(await apiGet(page.request, `/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/2`)).toMatchObject({close_reason: 'duplicate', close_duplicate_of: 1});
});

test('closing with another reason needs a description', async ({page}) => {
  const repo = await seed(page, ['Close as other']);
  const issue = () => apiGet(page.request, `/repos/${owner}/${repo}/issues/1`);
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/issues/1`);
  await pickReason(page, 'Other');
  await expect(page.locator('#status-button')).toHaveText('Close with other reason');
  await page.locator('#status-button').click(); // empty description: nothing is sent
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  expect((await issue()).state).toBe('open');
  await page.getByLabel('Close reason description').fill('obsolete');
  await page.locator('#status-button').click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', {name: 'Reopen Issue'})).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.locator('.issue-state-label')).toHaveText('Closed');
  await expect(page.locator('.timeline-item.event').last()).toContainText(/closed this\s+obsolete/, {useInnerText: true});
  expect(await issue()).toMatchObject({close_reason: 'other', close_reason_text: 'obsolete'});
});

test('bulk close offers issue reasons and records not planned', async ({page}) => {
  const repo = await seed(page, ['Bulk one', 'Bulk two']);
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/issues?state=open`);
  await page.locator('.issue-checkbox-all').check();
  const bulk = page.locator('#issue-actions [data-global-init="initIssueListCloseReason"]');
  await bulk.locator('.ui.dropdown').click();
  await expect(bulk.locator('.menu .item')).toHaveText(['Completed', 'Not planned']);
  await bulk.locator('.menu .item', {hasText: 'Not planned'}).click();
  const [response] = await Promise.all([
    page.waitForResponse((r) => r.url().includes('/issues/status')),
    page.waitForEvent('load'),
    bulk.getByRole('button', {name: 'Close as not planned'}).click(),
  ]);
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
  await page.goto(`/${owner}/${repo}/issues?state=closed`);
  await expect(page.locator('#issue-list .octicon-skip')).toHaveCount(2);
  await capture(page, 'bulk-closed');
